title: Assumptions & Constraints Manifest (ACM) Metadata Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for the YAML frontmatter of an Assumptions & Constraints Manifest (v1.0).

acm_version.description: Specification version of the ACM document.

risk_level.description: Author or agent operational risk assessment based on boundary stability.

contracts.description: Core operational and architectural runtime contract invariants.

idempotent.description: True if repeated executions with identical inputs produce identical side-effects without corruption.

concurrency_safe.description: True if execution is thread-safe and protected against race conditions, interleaving, and phantom reads under high concurrent load.

horizontal_scale_ready.description: True if execution does not rely on local in-memory state or single-node process locality and can run safely across multi-replica clusters.

strict_ordering_required.description: True if correct execution depends strictly on FIFO / monotonic ordering of incoming event streams or requests.

data_loss_safe.description: True if unhandled exceptions, power drops, or network blips guarantee zero silent message drops or unrecoverable state losses.

tags.description: Optional architectural, subsystem, or infrastructure tags.
